business_problem: When people are trading on financial markets through an app or a website, they want to know that they can trust the service to be fast, reliable, and secure. Online broker FXGT.com knew its customers deserved a high level of service in these areas, so it migrated to Amazon Web Services (AWS) to increase its scalability, availability, and performance.
solution_summary: When people are trading on financial markets through an app or a website, they want to know that they can trust the service to be fast, reliable, and secure. Online broker FXGT.com knew its customers deserved a high level of service in these areas, so it migrated to Amazon Web Services (AWS) to increase its scalability, availability, and performance. On AWS, FXGT.com can scale its databases and systems automatically when traffic spikes. “Companies like us have anomaly traffic: Sometimes traffic is very low; sometimes it’s huge. It depends on the market,” says Kapoulas. “With the scalability that using AWS provides, we can automatically scale based on the load to handle these traffic fluctuations without downtime.” The company can now double or triple its capacity in less than 3–4 minutes.

solution_components.name: Amazon Aurora
solution_components.role: Stores transactional data with higher throughput and availability.

solution_components.name: Amazon S3
solution_components.role: Stores documents, media, telemetry, or training data durably at scale.

solution_components.name: AWS Glue
solution_components.role: Prepares and moves data between operational sources and analytics or ML environments.

solution_components.name: Amazon Redshift
solution_components.role: Serves as the analytics warehouse for curated business data.

solution_components.name: Amazon CloudWatch
solution_components.role: Monitors infrastructure health and application performance.

solution_components.name: AWS Security Hub
solution_components.role: Aggregates security checks and centralized alerts.

business_outcome: Going forward, FXGT.com is looking to add additional AWS services for use cases such as machine learning and translation. “Whenever we need a new capability to help our business, AWS already has a solution, and one that will integrate with our existing systems,” says Kapoulas.
architecture_clues: To handle its data analytics, the company adopted Amazon Redshift , which uses SQL to analyze structured and semistructured data across data warehouses, databases, and data lakes.
On AWS, FXGT.com can serve clients globally through multiple licenses with no unplanned downtime and with low latency while maintaining security and regulatory compliance.
